name: Menu Pager
description: Block with previous/next links derived from a menu's order and structure.
provides_plugin_types: Block: menu_pager_block (Menu Pager) — derived once per menu (deriver Plugin/Derivative/MenuBlock, one block per menu entity); computes previous/next links from the active menu link's position in the flattened, access-checked menu tree; per-block settings restrict_to_parent, hide_menu_title, custom_label, previous_label, next_label; uncacheable (cache max-age 0, url.path context)
project_description: Menu Pager provides a block — derived once per menu — that shows previous and next links based on the current page's position within that menu. When the current route corresponds to a link in the block's menu, the module loads the menu tree, runs core's access-check and sort manipulators, flattens the tree depth-first, locates the active link by its plugin id, and renders the immediately preceding and following links as the previous/next pager. Disabled links and ignored routes (<nolink> and <separator> from Special Menu Items by default, extensible via hook_menu_pager_ignore_paths() / hook_menu_pager_ignore_paths_alter()) are excluded, and links the current user may not access are skipped. Per-block settings: 'Restrict to parent' (only consider siblings sharing the active link's parent instead of traversing the whole tree), 'Hide menu title' (show only the previous/next label), 'Display custom label' with 'Previous label' and 'Next label' textfields (override the default '<<' / '>>' markers). Output is themed via the menu_pager theme hook and menu-pager.html.twig template, with a small CSS library floating the previous link left and the next link right. The block is uncacheable (cache max-age 0) and varies by url.path. No dependencies beyond core; no permissions, routes, or Drush commands.
